newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay seeks one mln bbls of crude for May 12-14.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay seeks one mln bbls of crude for May 12-14.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP is seeking to buy one million barrels of crude for delivery May 12-14, trade sources said on Tuesday.
The tender will be awarded this Friday.
ANCAP has resumed its regular crude tenders to prepare for the re-start of the 34,600 barrels per day La Teja refinery early next month.
The facility has been shut for several months while a catalytic cracker is replaced.
In the interim, ANCAP has conducted several tenders for refined products.
